mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (actor_employee_id, target_employee_id, resource_type, resource_id, action) VALUES (#{actorEmployeeId}, #{targetEmployeeId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{action})
mapper.select: SELECT a.occurred_at, a.actor_employee_id, act.name AS actor_name, a.target_employee_id, tgt.name AS target_name, a.resource_type, a.resource_id, a.action FROM audit_log a JOIN employee act ON act.id = a.actor_employee_id JOIN employee tgt ON tgt.id = a.target_employee_id WHERE a.occurred_at >= #{startAt} AND a.occurred_at < #{endAt} ORDER BY a.occurred_at, a.id
